import importlib.util
import json
import time
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
import torch
from test_torch_online_checkpoint import equal_tree
from test_torch_online_learner import SOURCE, config, inputs, make_inputs

from harbichess.backends.torch_network import sha256
from harbichess.training.torch_online_learner import TorchOnlineLearner
from harbichess.training.torch_online_run import _journal, _memory_metric, _publish_once

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
    "cache_recovery", Path(__file__).with_name("cache-recovery.py")
)
helper = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(helper)
NEW_SOURCE = "b" * 40


def fixture(tmp_path):
    make_inputs(tmp_path)
    old_run = tmp_path / "old" / "run"
    new_run = tmp_path / "new" / "run"
    (old_run / "journal").mkdir(parents=True)
    (old_run / "checkpoints").mkdir()
    protocol = tmp_path / "protocol.json"
    protocol.write_text('{"unit":true}\n')
    input_paths = inputs(tmp_path) | {"protocol": protocol}
    cfg = asdict(config())
    cfg.pop("device")
    metadata = {
        "schema": 1,
        "source_commit": SOURCE,
        "config": cfg,
        "inputs": {
            name: {"relative_path": "../../" + path.name, "sha256": sha256(path)}
            for name, path in input_paths.items()
        },
        "max_updates": 100,
        "checkpoint_interval": 50,
        "absolute_deadline_epoch": time.time() + 120,
        "memory_max_bytes": 1024**4,
        "disk_min_free_bytes": 1,
    }
    if _memory_metric() != "cgroup-v2-current":
        metadata["memory_metric"] = _memory_metric()
    _publish_once(old_run / "metadata.json", metadata)
    learner = TorchOnlineLearner.fresh(
        config=config(), input_paths=input_paths, source_commit=SOURCE
    )
    learner.checkpoint(old_run / "checkpoints/step-00000000")
    for step in range(1, 4):
        _journal(old_run / "journal" / f"update-{step:08d}.json.gz", learner.train_update())
    proof = tmp_path / "proof.json"
    proof.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "status": "pass-e8-CUDA-cache-only-native-and-factual-journal-equivalence",
                "old_source_commit": SOURCE,
                "new_source_commit": NEW_SOURCE,
                "three_old_new_updates_all_models_adam_allRNG_actor_bits_exact": True,
                "three_factual_original_production_journals_matched": True,
                "freshprocess_regenerated_new_native_matches": True,
                "fixture_scope": "synthetic unit proof ONLY, not actual A100 evidence",
            }
        )
    )
    interruption = old_run.parent / "external-cache-interruption-v1.json"
    zero = old_run / "checkpoints/step-00000000"
    interruption.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "schema": "harbichess-owned-cache-interruption-v1",
                "status": "interrupted-original-production-cache-bottleneck",
                "new_source_planned": NEW_SOURCE,
                "seed": config().seed,
                "original_profile": {
                    "source_commit": SOURCE,
                    "seed": config().seed,
                    "absolute_deadline_epoch": metadata["absolute_deadline_epoch"],
                    "protocol_sha256": sha256(protocol),
                },
                "committed_prefix_updates": 3,
                "committed_prefix_transitions": 12,
                "committed_sample_chain_sha256": learner.sample_chain_sha256,
                "owned_processes": [],
                "original_native0_file_hashes": {p.name: sha256(p) for p in zero.iterdir()},
                "journal_inventory": [
                    {
                        "name": str(p.relative_to(old_run.parent)),
                        "size": p.stat().st_size,
                        "sha256": sha256(p),
                    }
                    for p in sorted((old_run / "journal").glob("update-*.json.gz"))
                ],
            }
        )
    )
    arguments = dict(
        old_run=old_run,
        new_run=new_run,
        old_source=SOURCE,
        new_source=NEW_SOURCE,
        prefix_updates=3,
        equivalence_proof=proof,
        interruption_receipt=interruption,
        git_addendum_sha256="c" * 64,
    )
    return learner, metadata, arguments


def test_exact_three_record_recovery_preserves_original_and_all_full_native_state(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch
):
    expected, metadata, arguments = fixture(tmp_path)
    old_run, new_run = arguments["old_run"], arguments["new_run"]
    inventory = {
        str(path.relative_to(old_run)): path.read_bytes()
        for path in old_run.rglob("*")
        if path.is_file()
    }
    # Unit boundary override only: no Git writes or production source proof.
    monkeypatch.setattr(helper, "_source_boundary", lambda *_args: None)
    receipt = helper.recover(**arguments)
    assert receipt["status"] == "complete" and receipt["matched_updates"] == 3
    assert receipt["duplicate_optimizer_updates_reexecuted"] == 3
    assert receipt["duplicate_selfplay_transitions_reexecuted"] == 12
    assert json.loads((new_run / "metadata.json").read_text()) == metadata | {
        "source_commit": NEW_SOURCE
    }
    actual = TorchOnlineLearner.resume(
        new_run / "checkpoints/step-00000003",
        config=config(),
        input_paths=inputs(tmp_path) | {"protocol": tmp_path / "protocol.json"},
        source_commit=NEW_SOURCE,
    )
    for left, right in (
        (expected.online, actual.online),
        (expected.base, actual.base),
        (expected.ema, actual.ema),
    ):
        equal_tree(left.state_dict(), right.state_dict())
    equal_tree(expected.optimizer.state_dict(), actual.optimizer.state_dict())
    assert expected.actors.cursor() == actual.actors.cursor()
    assert expected.actors.rng.getstate() == actual.actors.rng.getstate()
    assert expected.sample_chain_sha256 == actual.sample_chain_sha256
    bridge = json.loads((new_run / "source-bridge-v1.json").read_text())
    assert bridge["old_producer_source_commit"] == SOURCE
    assert bridge["new_producer_source_commit"] == NEW_SOURCE
    assert bridge["original_sample_chain_sha256"] == expected.sample_chain_sha256
    assert set(bridge["reconstructed_native_sha256"]) == {
        "checkpoints/step-00000000",
        "checkpoints/step-00000003",
    }
    assert {
        str(path.relative_to(old_run)): path.read_bytes()
        for path in old_run.rglob("*")
        if path.is_file()
    } == inventory
    expected_next, actual_next = expected.train_update(), actual.train_update()
    assert expected_next == actual_next
    assert torch.equal(
        expected.online.material_value_linear.weight, actual.online.material_value_linear.weight
    )


def test_corrupted_published_prefix_stops_and_never_publishes_nativeN(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _, _, arguments = fixture(tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(helper, "_source_boundary", lambda *_args: None)
    path = arguments["old_run"] / "journal/update-00000002.json.gz"
    import gzip

    record = json.loads(gzip.decompress(path.read_bytes()))
    record["samples"][0]["advantage"] += 0.01
    path.write_bytes(gzip.compress(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True).encode()))
    interruption = arguments["interruption_receipt"]
    receipt = json.loads(interruption.read_text())
    receipt["journal_inventory"][1].update(size=path.stat().st_size, sha256=sha256(path))
    interruption.write_text(json.dumps(receipt))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="online journal content hash differs"):
        helper.recover(**arguments)
    assert not arguments["new_run"].exists()


def test_zombie_owned_process_is_dead_but_same_identity_running_is_live(monkeypatch):
    fields = ["0"] * 20
    fields[19] = "9191"
    owner = {"pid": 123456789, "start_ticks": "9191"}
    fields[0] = "Z"
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "read_text", lambda self: "123 (owned) " + " ".join(fields))
    assert helper._owned_alive(owner) is False
    fields[0] = "S"
    assert helper._owned_alive(owner) is True
    assert helper._owned_alive(owner | {"start_ticks": "other"}) is False
